#include <rclcpp_action/rclcpp_action.hpp>

class FibonacciActionServerCppBase : public nodl_runtime_cpp::LifecycleNode
{
public:
  explicit FibonacciActionServerCppBase(const rclcpp::NodeOptions & options = rclcpp::NodeOptions{});

  virtual ~FibonacciActionServerCppBase() = default;

protected:

  // --- Action server callbacks ---
  virtual rclcpp_action::GoalResponse on_fibonacci_goal(const rclcpp_action::GoalUUID & uuid, std::shared_ptr<const example_interfaces::action::Fibonacci::Goal> goal) = 0;
  virtual rclcpp_action::CancelResponse on_fibonacci_cancel(std::shared_ptr<rclcpp_action::ServerGoalHandle<example_interfaces::action::Fibonacci>> goal_handle) = 0;
  /// @brief Called when a goal is accepted.  Do not block in this callback;
  /// doing so prevents cancel requests from being processed.  Detach a thread
  /// for long-running work, e.g.:
  ///   std::thread{[goal_handle]() { /* execute */ }}.detach();
  /// The node ends active goals when it deactivates, so a worker must check
  /// goal_handle->is_active() and stop on an ended goal.
  /// A terminal or feedback call that races the deactivation throws.
  virtual void on_fibonacci_accepted(std::shared_ptr<rclcpp_action::ServerGoalHandle<example_interfaces::action::Fibonacci>> goal_handle) = 0;

private:

  // --- Action servers ---
  nodl_runtime_cpp::ActiveOnlyActionServer<example_interfaces::action::Fibonacci>::SharedPtr action_srv_fibonacci_;
};

// fibonacci_action_server_cpp_base.cpp
// GENERATED FILE — do not edit. Regenerated from NoDL by nodl_generator_cpp.
#include "nodl_tutorial_lifecycle_action_cpp/fibonacci_action_server_cpp_base.hpp"

FibonacciActionServerCppBase::FibonacciActionServerCppBase(const rclcpp::NodeOptions & options)
: nodl_runtime_cpp::LifecycleNode("fibonacci_action_server_cpp", options)
{

  // Create action servers
  action_srv_fibonacci_ = std::make_shared<nodl_runtime_cpp::ActiveOnlyActionServer<example_interfaces::action::Fibonacci>>(
    this,
    "fibonacci",
    [this](const rclcpp_action::GoalUUID & uuid, std::shared_ptr<const example_interfaces::action::Fibonacci::Goal> goal) {
      return this->on_fibonacci_goal(uuid, goal);
    },
    [this](std::shared_ptr<rclcpp_action::ServerGoalHandle<example_interfaces::action::Fibonacci>> goal_handle) {
      return this->on_fibonacci_cancel(goal_handle);
    },
    [this](std::shared_ptr<rclcpp_action::ServerGoalHandle<example_interfaces::action::Fibonacci>> goal_handle) {
      this->on_fibonacci_accepted(goal_handle);
    });
  this->add_managed_entity(action_srv_fibonacci_);
}
